sleeve_gate.sentence: No sleeve-level gate earns adoption: switching the sleeve off on trend 25%, vol 30%, drawdown 17% of the decision grid is no better than switching it off on the same number of untimed decisions, so a gate here would buy a shorter holding period, not a signal. The closest arm is the vol gate: +0.86pp of drawdown against the frozen 1.0pp bar, and it does beat its own placebo by +6.06pp -- which is why it is named as the re-test candidate on new data, not re-thresholded here. Verdict NO_GATE.

rows.question: can the one-bar price be earned back by a causal rule
is anything visible between the close and the fill worth that price
does slicing the rebalance over k opens buy anything

research_arc.sentence: **Research arc: all three asks were priced and none paid.** E25 IRRECOVERABLE (+0.17pp best arm `smooth_k2`), E26 MIXED_ACROSS_PHASES (+0.89pp best arm `excl_upgap_q80`), E27 NO_SLICING_EDGE (+0.08pp best arm `k5`). So the gap between the printed number and the tradable one is not recoverable by smoothing the score, not visible in the overnight gap, and not saved by slicing the fill over k opens. This is not a claim that no lever exists -- it is the narrower, earned claim that these three do not pay, and that a fourth question has to come from somewhere other than this rule's own mechanics.

verdict.criteria: ROWS_NOT_COMPARABLE iff at least one dial moves the held config by >= tol_pp_per_year on at least one window; SAME_RULER if none does. The published gap between row 1 and row 3 is decomposed into these dials, and no dial's price is inferred from another.

window.note: 同一条定价路径，只换起点。差的是**时期**不是策略——正因为如此，两行按两段时期读、却被放在同一个「全窗」表头下

universe.note: 同一本书、同一段、同一时点，只换能挑的品种类别

ordering.note: 同一本书（5 名、不挂覆盖）、同一股票池、同一段，只换信号什么时候被读到。这一格在**书层面**读，不挂 beta 覆盖：open-to-open 的净值序列比收盘口径早一个 bar（下面「为什么覆盖只挂在次开那一侧」那张表是本面的实测），拿它拟合 beta 会读到一个不是这本书的 beta，所以覆盖只挂在 next-open 那一侧

cost.note: 同一本书、同一段、同一股票池、同一时点，只换每边假设的成本
